scope: Research report only; no production/configuration or locale-pack changes, no next language batch.

metric_correction.metric: Estimated global population reachable through at least one supported language/script, using official mother-tongue, second-language or functional-language populations as comprehension proxies.
metric_correction.denominator: All global population; not adults, literate people, Internet users or gamers.
metric_correction.clarification_zh: 前版有关识字及年龄的诊断不能成为用户没有要求的完整全球识字下界门槛。本版按语言理解人口代理估计：母语群体直接作为语言可达代理，第二语言只在有统计且能去重时计入；不证明每个人现在识字。
metric_correction.script_distinctions_still_required: Do not credit a different written language/standard merely because it shares a language family or script. Explicitly distinguish Hindi/Urdu, Gurmukhi/Shahmukhi Punjabi, Hans/Hant Chinese and regional written standards.
metric_correction.source_age_scope_only: When a particular source already measures ages5plus or ages1plus, retain its stated universe and convert its numerator to the all-population denominator; that is source accounting, not an added readability gate. No countrywide age cutoff is imposed on the C16 mother-tongue proxy.
metric_correction.effect_on_prior_reports: Historical source evidence and arithmetic remain preserved. Revision3 literal-reading stop gates are superseded for this user-intended proxy metric; its sensitivity observations do not invalidate a clearly labelled language-population estimate.

decision.summary_zh: 建议以点估计至少83%、固定扣除3个全球百分点后仍至少80%，并通过预先声明的压力情景，作为语言人口代理估算的停止规则。此规则是可复算的保守估计政策，不是2026真实人口的统计保证。当前仅中英已发布，西语仍待既定验收；下面的语言清单只是预算和收益研究。

recommended_model.point_formula: C(S)=sum_t P_t * max(M_t(S),D_t(S)) / sum_t P_t; M is maximum supported exact language/script marginal and D is an audited sum of mutually exclusive supported mother-tongue leaves or joint L1/L2 categories. Express as percent.
recommended_model.country_rule: Within a country, sum only source-defined exclusive cohorts. When overlap is unknown, take a maximum. Do not add a census union to overlapping English/Hindi/other L2 counts or add the census union to the CLDR maximum.
recommended_model.india: D_IN(S)=sum selected exact named C16 mother-tongue leaves /1210854977. Exclude uppercase parent totals and Others. The current research ledger has26 exact-leaf candidates, including18 earlier transcriptions and8 additional named leaves listed below.
recommended_model.indonesia: If id is supported, D_ID=.98115*(284667253-22741968)/284667253. This credits only the measured ages5plus language-ability numerator; no literacy test is added.
recommended_model.other_countries: Use the maximum exact supported CLDR language/script marginal until reliable disjoint official cohorts are reconciled. Official joint sources can subsequently replace or strengthen this estimate using the same event/proxy definition.
recommended_model.historical_share_assumption: A country language share observed in2011/2025 is used as an approximate share under the frozen population weights. This is an explicit stationarity estimate, not a proof that its current share cannot fall.
recommended_model.time_statement: Publish all source years and the population snapshot. Updating official population weights is allowed while retaining historical language shares as estimates; recompute the forecast after the weight update. It need not await a new census in every country.
recommended_model.geographic_conservatism: For this reproducible forecast, AC/TA/DG/EA/IC contribute zero extra numerator while the full frozen denominator is retained, avoiding credit for these potentially overlapping special territories. Reconcile other country/area scopes during final evidence review.
recommended_model.population_not_person_identity_tracking: Use estimated current-resident country fractions. Do not simultaneously count old origin-country survivors and newer destination-country resident stocks as distinct people.

buffer_policy.decision_rule: C_decision=min(B_fixed,B_stress); stop numerically only if C_decision>=80 before rounding.
buffer_policy.meaning: Stress the old Indian language-share contribution down10% relative, all other modeled contributions down2% relative, and reserve another0.05 global percentage point. The fixed3pp reserve remains the minimum even when this stress deduction is smaller.
buffer_policy.what_buffer_is_for: Historical-share drift, approximate mixed-source marginals, minor population/geographic revisions and displayed precision within the stated estimation policy.
buffer_policy.not_for: It cannot legitimize duplicate cohort counting, incompatible scripts, an untranslated locale, an invented source value or a known material source error. Correct those inputs or exclude the affected cohort first.
buffer_policy.honest_label_zh: 约3个百分点的决策缓冲及明确压力情景；并非95%置信下界，也不声称未知误差一定被这3个百分点覆盖。发现更大的已知风险时应增加缓冲或降低相应覆盖贡献，不能为过线临时缩小缓冲。

prospective_results.existing_spanish_status: Candidate pending the existing native UI/revalidation/release gate; not credited as delivered by this research.
prospective_results.budget_qualification: Approximate planning range, not an optimized minimum. Additional standard/script splits, failed native reviews, current population weights or source corrections can increase it. Some larger languages require multiple regional versions even when the source-language-family count is one.
prospective_results.script_family_eligibility_assumption: The source-language family enters this forecast only when all declared relevant supported written standards/scripts for the credited cohort are eligible. A family appearing once in the list does not mean one script-only translation automatically covers all its variants.

additional_india_exact_leaf_candidates.locator: Census of India2011, Paper1of2018, Statement1, exact named mother-tongue leaf rows, printed pages6-7 (PDF pages7-8).
additional_india_exact_leaf_candidates.provenance_limit: Numbers are primary-author publication transcriptions read via the previously identified mirror; byte identity to the official download and original XLSX cells remain unverified. This is disclosed estimate-source provenance, not a claim of original-workbook verification. Reconcile or independently review the numeric rows before incorporating them in a production evidence ledger.
additional_india_exact_leaf_candidates.counting_example: Use Kashmiri6554369 rather than KASHMIRI6797587; Santali6973345 rather than SANTALI7368192; Konkani2146906 rather than KONKANI2256502. Generic totals are not added to constituent leaves.

script_and_standard_handling.execution_rule: Keep one population cohort once. Support distinct writing forms where needed, or credit only the documented compatible share; do not assign the entire cohort to an arbitrary one-script variant merely because CLDR has a default script.
examples: zh-CN/Hans and zh-Hant remain separate; do not credit Cantonese or other Chinese languages through either by default.
Indian Punjabi/Gurmukhi does not credit Pakistani Punjabi/Shahmukhi.
A Hindi/Devanagari pack does not automatically credit Urdu/Arabic or Bhojpuri/Rajasthani/Magahi/Chhattisgarhi leaves.
Konkani, Kashmiri, Manipuri and Santali version families are budgeted explicitly; alternative scripts add versions, not additional people.
script_and_standard_handling.no_individual_literacy_proof_required: These are language-population proxies with compatible localization standards. No survey proving that every individual can read each script is imposed; unresolved broad standard mismatches still need explicit scope/mapping.

benefit_ranked_inventory.basis: After the currently pending Spanish batch eventually passes, start from zh/en/es. Among source-language candidates repeatedly select the largest incremental decision-estimate gain; exact ties sorted by code. This is a feasible greedy plan, not a proof of minimum number of languages.
benefit_ranked_inventory.note: No language pack or next batch is started by this inventory. Before implementation, select the next batch only after the current release gate and review script/RTL/font/native-review work.

official_sources_for_future_estimate_imp.rule: National mother-tongue columns are mutually exclusive. Resolve why Table11 universe differs from the full census population and geographic coverage before scaling; missing numerator receives no automatic credit. Punjabi Arab/Guru and Hindko/Balochi broader categories require explicit standard mappings.
official_sources_for_future_estimate_imp.reason: Existing CLDR Urdu marginal is95%, so naive mother-tongue addition is both unnecessary and invalid; gain may be small even with many additional packs.

official_sources_for_future_estimate_imp.table: 2.8 language most often spoken in household
official_sources_for_future_estimate_imp.rule: Household-primary-language categories can form a disjoint proxy union. Preserve that construct and its ages1plus universe; do not call it an individual literacy test or add English L2 to the same residents.
official_sources_for_future_estimate_imp.source_universe_note: Table2.8 excludes younger than1. Table2.5 reports0-4 population5833515 of62027503. Source-scope adjustment can use a documented conservative denominator conversion, or an explicit household-language assumption; it is not a universal new child-age gate.
official_sources_for_future_estimate_imp.reason: A useful future group can improve the estimate. A single-language greedy procedure can miss complementary household-language bundles, so a group search may reduce the required total pack count.

practical_stop_standard.headline_stop: Estimated global language-population coverage >=80% after the predeclared buffer and conservative overlap policy.
requirements: Use only completed, independently reviewed and released locales/standards in the delivered set; current Spanish remains a candidate until its existing gate passes.
Freeze and publish the language-data sources, years, population weights, exact cohort selectors, script/standard mappings, assumptions and buffer policy.
Within countries use disjoint mother-tongue/joint-language groups or a maximum when overlap is unknown. Remove group/child duplicates and geographic duplicate credit.
Resolve known standard incompatibilities by separate variants, supported shares or exclusion; do not hide them inside the numerical error buffer.
Recompute after each release or material source/population update; independently review the evidence ledger and the language set used by the estimator.
Report this as an estimate based on official language-population proxies and historical-share assumptions, not a2026 person-by-person guarantee or statistical confidence lower bound.
not_required_as_extra_gates: A complete global literacy lower bound
A uniform age exclusion for every country
Proof that every counted individual currently reads the UI
A simultaneous new language census in every country
practical_stop_standard.reason_now: The forecast requires many prospective language/script versions. Current released-set coverage is far below80; the numerical source ledger, mappings and adopted estimator still need normal independent review before use.

source_reliability_and_limitations.hierarchy: Prefer official census/survey joint or exclusive cohorts; use the original authored census publication as primary numeric evidence with disclosed mirror provenance; use CLDR functional marginals where no stronger compatible evidence is available.
source_reliability_and_limitations.original_india_workbook_status: Still unavailable via normal download; no permission/certificate bypass or invented original cell validation is claimed. Replacing a primary authored publication with its XLSX counterpart would improve auditability but does not change the proxy metric into a literacy requirement.
source_reliability_and_limitations.unknown_estimation_error: The3pp policy buffer is a stated practical assumption, not an empirically validated universal bound on CLDR/census extrapolation error. If stronger data materially lowers a contribution, recompute and continue the rollout rather than preserving a pass.
source_reliability_and_limitations.population_years: CLDR48 population snapshot, C16 observed2011, BPS SUPAS2025. This is a frozen-weight global estimate, not a harmonized exact2026 population census.
source_reliability_and_limitations.estimated_pack_count_is_conditional: The90-100 version budget depends on expanded C16 fine leaves, script-family delivery and the frozen weights. It can change with native review, current official population weights or additional primary sources.
